facts.fact: Simone 开场自认"泼冷水"：本条 Hype 是坏消息通报。
facts.anchor: I hate to be a buzzkill, but I have some bad news.

facts.fact: 烟花大秀因浮动驳船（floating barge）的设备故障取消。
facts.anchor: Our fireworks extravaganza is cancelled due to an equipment malfunction on the floating barge.

facts.fact: 官方道歉并承诺尽快择期重办烟花秀。
facts.anchor: We apologize and hope to reschedule the event soon.

facts.fact: 安保团队正在追踪岛上"可疑活动"——细节不能透露，只说是"小规模调查、无需惊慌"。
facts.anchor: our security team is tracking some suspicious activity on the island

facts.fact: 为配合安保，所有客人须天黑前回房并一直待到早晨——全岛性质的禁足令。
facts.anchor: we’re asking all guests to return to their rooms before dark and remain there until morning.
